gbifID.description: Unique numeric identifier for each Rusa timorensis occurrence record.

datasetKey.description: A unique identifier for the dataset containing the occurrence records.

occurrenceID.description: Unique iNaturalist observation URLs identifying individual Rusa timorensis records.

kingdom.description: The kingdom is consistently recorded as Animalia for all occurrences.

phylum.description: The phylum for all Rusa timorensis records is Chordata.

class.description: Taxonomic class of the Rusa timorensis specimens, consistently recorded as Mammalia.

order.description: Taxonomic order classification for the Rusa timorensis species.

family.description: The family of the Rusa timorensis specimens, consistently identified as Cervidae.

genus.description: Genus is a categorical string field containing the taxonomic genus name.

species.description: The species name for the Timor deer occurrence records.

infraspecificEpithet.description: This column is entirely empty, containing no recorded infraspecific epithet values.

taxonRank.description: The taxon rank for all records is consistently identified as species.

scientificName.description: The scientific name of the species, formatted with author and year.

verbatimScientificName.description: The verbatim scientific name of the Rusa timorensis species.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: This column is entirely empty, containing no recorded scientific name authorship data.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes for species occurrence locations.

locality.description: All values are missing, indicating no recorded locality data for these occurrence records.

stateProvince.description: Geographic state or province of the Rusa timorensis occurrence record.

occurrenceStatus.description: The occurrence status of Rusa timorensis records, consistently recorded as present.

individualCount.description: All values are missing, indicating no individual count data is recorded.

publishingOrgKey.description: Unique identifier for the publishing organization.

decimalLatitude.description: Decimal latitude coordinates of Rusa timorensis occurrences, ranging from -36.79 to 4.38 degrees.

decimalLongitude.description: Decimal longitude coordinates in degrees, ranging from -50.14 to 166.83.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Coordinate uncertainty radius in meters for species occurrence records.

coordinatePrecision.description: The coordinate precision field is entirely empty.

elevation.description: Elevation data is entirely missing from the records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation accuracy is not recorded for any occurrence records.

depth.description: All values are null, indicating no depth data is recorded for these occurrences.

depthAccuracy.description: This column is entirely empty, containing no recorded depth accuracy values.

eventDate.description: Timestamps of species observation events ranging from 1986 to 2026.

day.description: Day of the month for the Rusa timorensis occurrence record, ranging from 1 to 31.

month.description: Month of observation, expressed as an integer from 1 to 12.

year.description: Integer values representing the calendar year of species occurrence records.

taxonKey.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier for the Rusa timorensis taxon.

speciesKey.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier for the Rusa timorensis species.

basisOfRecord.description: The method used to record the species occurrence, specifically human observation.

institutionCode.description: The institution code identifies the source of the occurrence records.

collectionCode.description: The collection code for all records is Observations.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier for each Rusa timorensis occurrence record.

recordNumber.description: This column is entirely empty and contains no data.

identifiedBy.description: Identifier of the person who identified the Rusa timorensis specimen.

dateIdentified.description: Timestamp of species observation in ISO 8601 format.

license.description: The license field specifies Creative Commons usage terms for the occurrence records.

rightsHolder.description: Identifier of the individual or organization holding the rights to the occurrence record.

recordedBy.description: Identifier of the individual who recorded the Rusa timorensis occurrence.

typeStatus.description: The typeStatus column is entirely empty, containing no recorded values.

lastInterpreted.description: Timestamp of the last data interpretation for each occurrence record.

mediaType.description: Media type of occurrence records, primarily still images.

issue.description: Semicolon-separated codes indicating data quality issues such as rounded coordinates or missing taxon identifiers.

rusa_timorensis.description: 1000 Rusa timorensis occurrence records with taxonomic, geographic, and temporal data.

description: Contains 1000 Rusa timorensis occurrence records spanning 1989 to 2026.
